classification_method.era_detection_defect: the instrument reported shape_era='A' for all three files and gated on parseable_answers, because _shape_era() (tools/tranche_canary.py:274-280) returns 'A' the moment ANY row carries a truthy stop_reason -- and every era-B row here carries both stop_reason and finish_reason. So the instrument's 'shape_ok' for transcript-compact is an ERA-A shape_ok and does not by itself satisfy this card's era-B gate; the era-B gate (answer_verified>=1 AND stop_signal_source=finish_reason) was applied by hand from the rows above.
rules_applied: CANARY-ERA-B-FIX: shape_ok requires answer_verified>=1 and stop_signal_source=finish_reason (finish_reason fallback when the source field is absent), never averaged with parseable_answers
TRANCHE-CANARY: a full-ceiling completion inside the window is shape_degenerate and names its turn; shape_unknown is never rounded to shape_ok
this card: any cap-length completion inside the 12-turn window => shape_degenerate

decision.rule_fired: any shape_degenerate => grid_may_launch false (pointer-stable turn 4; transcript-grow turns 1,2,4,5,11) AND any shape_unknown => grid_may_launch false (lease-reopen, never ran)
decision.degenerate_cause_reading: tool channel. Across all 36 requests there are ZERO structured tool calls (tool_calls=[] on every row of all three arms), and transcript-grow turn 1 shows the exact failure mode: the model writes the call as fenced text instead of invoking it. The fixture instruction supplies the invitation to read, and the model's answer format is what collapses into prose -- but the channel is the defect, because a working channel would have parsed a call or refused it, not silently billed 4096 tokens of narration.
decision.secondary_cause: fixture/answer format: the checkpoint line ('ANSWER: NONE') is reachable (transcript-compact produces it in 18 tokens) but nothing in the instructions makes the model call read_file before answering, so two arms never read at all
decision.one_measurement_that_would_resolve_lease: re-run cell 15 alone (lease-reopen, 12 turns) after the launcher's precondition-10 stop is repaired or scoped to the non-zero-marker arms, and classify its 12 rows with the era-B gate; that single cell costs 12 requests.
decision.not_softened_by: the live canary DID run and DID spend 36 requests -- this is not a refusal. It is a measured HOLD, and the HOLD is the successful result of this card.
